daily.summary: The assessee conducted a retail business in gold and silver ornaments at Palacode, Dharmapuri, under the name M/s. Vasavi Thangamaligai. During a Section 133A survey on 26 February 2014, the Department found 8,502.899 grams of gold stock against 6,352.839 grams recorded in the books. daily.title: NMDC battles weak offtake despite strong steel demand

Steelmakers are increasingly meeting their additional requirements of ore—a key input—through captive mining. NMDC’s October sales fell 12% year-on-year (y-o-y), partly due to rail disruption slowing ore dispatches, belying expectations of a post-monsoon recovery. In the first seven months of FY27, volumes fell 2% to 25.7 million tonnes (mt), while output rose 22% to 32.3 mt.

daily.title: Senior Citizen Tax Rates For Tax Year 2026-27: With Example on Different Income Levels
daily.summary: Senior citizens in India can pay tax under two systems: the New Regime and the Old Regime.For Tax Year 2026–27, the New Regime has the same slabs for ever This guide compares the two in simple steps, so you can pick the one that saves you more tax. Tax Year 2026–27 is the same period as FY 2026–27 (AY 2027–28) under the older terminology. Tax is progressive, so each rate applies only to the income inside its band. A 4% Health and Education Cess is added on top, and a surcharge applies at higher incomes.

breaking.title: Overnight rates cross RBI’s MSF rate as liquidity tightens; VRR demand surges
breaking.summary: Banks are increasingly relying on the RBI's short-term liquidity windows as funding pressures intensify, pushing overnight rates past the ceiling of the policy corridor Overnight money market rates hardened further on November 26, as the weighted average call rate (WACR) rose to 5.80 percent from 5.73 percent a day earlier, breaching the RBI’s 5.75 percent Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) rate. The rate movements reflect tighter liquidity conditions and rising demand for short-term funds in the banking system. The benchmark WACR rose from 5.55 percent on November 18, pointing to increasing pressure on banks to meet immediate funding requirements.
